scope: Full TeX/code reading of Fennel, Heather and Juniper. This is editorial interpretation, not numeric novelty, independence, correctness, usability or popularity measurement.
status_meaning: explicit/partial/absent mark treatment in the report; an explicit design is not an implemented or Lean-verified system.

dimensions.core: Conservative Lean elaboration and proof acceptance; kernel changes require a measured reason
dimensions.anchor: Evidence about the same object, scoped to an actual context and preserved by checked transport
dimensions.structures: Structure and witness data selected separately from proof-only properties
dimensions.behavior: Relational/dependent behavioral consequence and composition at actual values
dimensions.bounded: Finite/budgeted inference with a stated grounding boundary
dimensions.observation: Explicit observation/transport guarantees and source-level realization boundaries
dimensions.leant: Exact-candidate proof-linked behavioral synthesis, distinct from receipt/association
dimensions.checker: Denotation, checker soundness, execution evidence and original-target bridge
dimensions.fidelity: Statement, required-method and kernel truth distinguished
dimensions.evaluation: Matched Lean baselines, artifact costs, held-out tasks and substantive stopping rules
dimensions.frontier: Alternative sufficient support sets and the distinction between route soundness and coverage
dimensions.admissibility: Completeness on the actual admitted observation image

Fennel.distinctive: Named proof-root antichains; implemented rule allowlists; evidence-availability versus meaning-edit maintenance; q-Pochhammer guarded representations; uncountable a.e. quantifier counterexample.

core.qualification: Initial property-implicit elaboration compiles to ordinary proofs; explicit primitive refinement fragment has a paper subtype translation, not a verified new kernel.

anchor.qualification: Local proof overlays keep values; typed transport and edit classification specified. Implemented fingerprint guard is exact finite request identity, not general Lean context transport.

structures.qualification: Fixed structures precede proof search; dependent finite-tensor construction keeps factor finite/free assumptions and actual equivalence/naturality data.

behavior.qualification: Actual intermediate value and dependent output guarantees; distinguishes guarded total functions from restricted-domain implementations. Not implemented by Horn parser.

bounded.qualification: Finite graph closure implemented with100000 default attempts/10000 retained-node cap; real Lean grounding only specified. Exponential output measured.

observation.qualification: Exact versus guarded quotient forms, neighborhood versus point equality, measure and quantifier order retained. These mathematical consumers are design examples.

leant.qualification: Callback receipt versus behavioral theorem; exact selected edit and candidate bridge required; no Leant adapter delivered.

checker.qualification: Route checker is implemented Python on opaque implications. General CAS denotation/execution/original-target bridge specified; neither whole-frontier coverage nor mathematical reifier implemented.

fidelity.qualification: Fixed statement plus mandatory rule profile distinct from hints. using-only enforced in small calculus; no human-intent or transitive dependency-essentiality theorem.

evaluation.qualification: L0-L4 and renderer controls; same services/theorems, repair/reading costs, stop if Lean library or renderer explains benefits. No user study.

frontier.qualification: Exact antichain semantics over named pending roots; individual derivation certificates only. Completeness flag is producer result, not independently certified.

admissibility.qualification: Written full-Nat affine grammar criterion with List Empty and joint-realization correction. No domain-frame implementation.

Heather.distinctive: Realizable affine frames and rank-minimal determining families; actual list AST/domain statements rendered to Lean; a tiny exact-anchor/epoch Nat consumer resolver.

core.qualification: Paper conservative core interpretation and primitive-subtype alternative; no verified parser/compiler or measured kernel-encoding obstruction.

anchor.qualification: Exact typed subjects and snapshots; context substitution/equality/iff transport specified, while toy rejects cross-anchor and stale epochs.

structures.qualification: Only Prop-valued requirements implicit; structures/data/witnesses fixed or explicitly constructed; finite tensor package keeps shared W and naturality.

behavior.qualification: Correct pre/post implication directions; actual intermediate and input/output relation; whole-function properties retained. Not a general behavioral elaborator.

bounded.qualification: Ground term-pool cardinality bound before closure and partial explanations; implemented resolver has only Nat positive/nonzero consequences.

observation.qualification: Exact source observation bridge, affine equality only, measure-specific transport and quantitative result strength; no promotion to content/sortedness.

leant.qualification: Exact-candidate correspondence and provider law proofs required. Python AST/model/frame operations exist; Exference/Leant handoff does not.

checker.qualification: Rechecker recomputes fixed models/frames and concrete witness evaluations, but shares parser/model code; no Lean checker-soundness theorem.

fidelity.qualification: Method hint versus enforced recipe, same typed document model, fixed meaning. Actual list guards emitted; no general narrative publication implementation.

evaluation.qualification: Same libraries/services and ordinary automatic parameters permitted in controls; charge coverage/provider/maintenance costs; no native or human timing study.

frontier.qualification: Ordinary finite fact closure and operation-specific unresolved routes specified; no full alternative-support antichain enumeration or completeness checker.

admissibility.qualification: Written realized affine-frame theorem and r+1 dimension criterion; implemented free/empty/diagonal/even frames. No automatic arbitrary-domain hull discovery.

Juniper.distinctive: Independent finite-frontier seed/rule-coverage checker; separate grounding/closure flags; residual telescopes; analytic inverse-derivative recurrence and quotient descent.

core.qualification: Ordinary Lean proof terms first; kernel alternative requires separate metatheory and measured cost. Architecture theorem assumes correct fixed meanings.

anchor.qualification: Typed terms, structures/context and dependent indices anchor evidence; first version rebuilds after edits. Prototype only exact-profile matching.

structures.qualification: Chosen bases/inverses are data; rows are proofs. General residuals keep witness dependencies; finite engine runs after data arguments fixed.

behavior.qualification: Guarded total functions distinct from subtype-domain functions; consequence/composition use actual implementation and intermediate values.

bounded.qualification: Finite graph plus optional attempt cap; grounding and graph closure coverage separated in design. Python cap is not a wall-clock/memory bound.

observation.qualification: Preservation/reflection, List Empty realizability, joint outputs, precision and measure-indexed contracts. Analytic/formal bridge explicit.

leant.qualification: Preserves callback receipt and provider-law boundaries; stronger result retains exact term plus Spec proof; no executed Leant adapter.

checker.qualification: Python independently validates route derivations and complete-family coverage; generic Lean export proves routes only. CAS semantics and original-target bridge specified.

fidelity.qualification: Logical, statement and recipe fidelity distinct; unused displayed assertions also require acceptance. Prototype only finite implication source semantics.

evaluation.qualification: Matched Lean/library/service/interface/narrative and renderer controls; held-out families and stop rules; no productivity result.

frontier.qualification: Complete antichain of offered propositions; checkable seed/rule closure beyond individual-route soundness; no Lean formalization of completeness.

admissibility.qualification: Written exact List-length image and unary affine criterion for empty/inhabited element types; no Heather-style domain-frame implementation.

cross_lane_evidence.comparisons: 128 shared finite profiles;768 atom frontiers;89 selected Fennel routes;128 Juniper result checks. Finite agreement only; named proof roots and proposition offers differ outside shared representation.
cross_lane_evidence.publication_hazard: Fennel and Heather preserve old positive Lean files when the same output folder is reused for a later no-route/negative request. This is stale artifact correspondence risk, not an accepted false proof.
